results.explanation: At the supplied entry, the handler retrieves the requested item by ID and returns 404 if it does not exist. Its decisive authorization control permits the read when the injected current_user is a superuser; otherwise it requires the item owner_id to equal current_user.id and returns 403 when that ownership check fails. Therefore, the handler proves conditionally that an item belonging to another user can be read if CurrentUser supplies an active superuser. The supplied path does not prove that the external caller is the current_user injected by that dependency, nor that the injected identity has active-superuser status. Without that caller-to-current_user binding, it does not prove that the actual caller can read the item. Source discovery is not-tested, so no repository-wide or deployment conclusion is made.

binding.statement: The handler obtains the requested item by the supplied ID and uses the item's owner_id in the authorization comparison.

control.statement: The strongest visible authorization control bypasses the ownership requirement when current_user.is_superuser is true; otherwise it rejects an item whose owner_id differs from current_user.id.

effect.statement: After the authorization check, the handler returns the retrieved item.
